correctness.rationale: Every one of \(2^n\) inputs for each n=1..23 is represented by an exact reversal orbit, every substring composition is tallied in a full exact byte-signature, and equality of whole signatures determines fibers. Finite exhaustive enumeration finds counts and a separate prefix-sum-difference C++ implementation recomputes all 23 histograms and all 160 four-word fibers. 4096+2*4191936+4*160=8388608. No extrapolation beyond 23 is claimed.

value.rationale: Full substring-composition reconstruction is an established motivated channel, and its foundational paper explicitly identifies counting distinct composition observations as mathematically interesting. The length-23 case is the first with known noninterleaved ambiguity examples, so its complete exact fiber distribution and 160 explicit ambiguous classes are natural finite benchmarks; distinct-output count directly equals maximum noiseless code size. This is a meaningful exact natural finite classification, not an arbitrary parameter-only sample.
